To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
porous zirconia capillary membranes were fabricated and characterized for immobilization of enzymes through click chemistry.
porous ceramic capillary microtubes were successfully prepared and characterized for enzyme immobilization through click chemistry.
we have fabricated and characterized porous ceramic capillaries with different particle size blends, different porosities and surface functionalizations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and characterization of porous zirconia microtubes as a new class of membrane materials for enzyme functionalization.
the development of a porous ceramic capillary membrane for the immobilization of enzymes.
the preparation, characterization and optimization of ceramic membranes with respect to the immobilization of acetylene-terminated enzymes through click chemistry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the capillary membranes are suitable for the immobilization of enzymes.
the zirconia capillary membrane is a suitable candidate for the immobilization of acetylene functional enzymes through click chemistry.
zirconia capillary membranes with a pore size of 1-2 µm are suitable for the immobilization of enzymes through click chemistry, leading to a high activity of the enzyme.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a method to produce porous ceramic capillaries and functionalized them with enzymes through click chemistry.
we have shown that it is possible to produce ceramic capillaries with different properties, which can be used for different applications.
we were able to manufacture porous zirconia capillary membranes, which were successfully functionalized with acetylene groups, and finally, enzyme immobilized on it through click chemistry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the zirconia microcapillaries are promising candidates for enzyme immobilization.
the zirconia powder particle size plays an important role in both mechanical and permeability performance.
the capillaries are suitable for enzyme immobilization, and that their performance can be tailored by changing the zirconia blend composition.
